title: Fluxion graph spec
description: A graph for Fluxion (https://osmansiddiquer.github.io/Fluxion/). Put it in a link as #spec=<percent-encoded or base64url JSON> or #z=<base64url(deflate-raw(JSON))>. Expression syntax: https://osmansiddiquer.github.io/Fluxion/llms.txt

expressions.description: One entry per row in the app, in order.

viewport.description: Visible window. x is the horizontal axis. The grid is always square: xmin/xmax are exact, the y-range is re-centred on (ymin+ymax)/2 to fit the window shape. Defaults: x -8..8, y -5..5.

features.description: Inspection markers shown on curves, and the grid.

grid.description: Grid lines and axes. Turn off for drawings / animations.

equilibria.description: Equilibria of autonomous ODEs with their stability (filled = stable, hollow = unstable, half = saddle): y = c lines for one equation against t, points in the phase plane.

right.description: Panel of every curve's value at x = sliceX.

bottom.description: Panel of where each curve crosses y = sliceY.

aspect.description: Fixed aspect ratio (width / height, 0.1 to 10, e.g. 2.39 or "16/9"): the plot is letterboxed to that frame (black bars), and x from xmin to xmax spans the frame exactly, so the composition is the same on every screen.

fps.description: Fixed playback rate, 1 to 240: sliders advance in whole frames, and frame N is a pure function of N (deterministic playback).

time.description: Open paused at this time in seconds: every autoplay slider is set to its value that long after the start. For rendering one exact frame (also as &time= after any link).

frame.description: Like time, in frames at fps (default 30): time = floor(frame) / fps. Also as &frame= after any link.

script.description: A Script mode program: JavaScript using the Fluxion drawing API (circle, polygon, path, group, hsv, slider, time, graph.ode, ...). It runs sandboxed and draws on the same axes as the expressions. See the Script section of llms.txt.

exprString.description: Plain-text expression, e.g. "y = sin(x)", "y'' = -y", "k = 2", "x^2 + y^2 = 9", "r = 1 + cos(theta)", "y < x", "(1, 2)", "(cos(t), sin(t))", "f(u) = u^2", "(k, k^2) for k = 0..3".

number.description: A finite number, or a constant expression string such as "2pi" or "-pi/2". |value| <= 1e9.

numberOrExpr.description: A number, a constant like "pi", or an expression over sliders like "k".

color.description: "#rrggbb", "#rgb" or a palette name. Default: next unused palette colour.

ic.description: ODE: initial state [y(t0), y'(t0), ...], one value per order (default [1, 0, ...]).

speed.description: Slider: play speed (1 = a full sweep in about 4 s).

thetaMin.description: Polar curve/region: start angle; parametric curve (x(t), y(t)): start of t (default 0).

thetaMax.description: Polar curve/region: end angle; parametric curve: end of t (default 2pi; at most 50 turns from thetaMin).

lineWidth.description: Stroke width in px (default 2.25; 0 hides the stroke).

fill.description: Fill closed shapes (parametric, polar, polygons; inequalities fill by default).

fillOpacity.description: Fill opacity (default 0.4 for shapes, 0.16 for regions).

colorExpr.description: Colour expression over sliders, overriding color: rgb(r,g,b) 0-255, rgba(r,g,b,a), hsv(h,s,v) / hsl(h,s,l) with h in degrees, e.g. "hsv(360*a, 0.8, 1)".

fillColor.description: Fill colour (hex or colour expression); defaults to the line colour.

autoplay.description: Slider: start playing when the graph opens.

samples.description: Own sample count, 8 to 20000 (function / parametric / polar curves; grid cells across x for implicit curves and regions). Raise it for smooth hero shapes, lower it for cheap background ones.

dots.description: Polylines: show (true) or hide (false) the vertex dots. Default: shown on plain polylines, hidden on filled, repeated and smooth paths.

blend.description: Blend mode for this expression's fill and line (add = additive light, screen = soft light).

glow.description: Glow radius in px, 0 to 50 (a soft halo in the line / fill colour). Costly on big shapes.

blur.description: Gaussian blur radius in px, 0 to 50. Costly on big shapes.

layer.description: Draw this expression on the layer defined by a row `name = layer(dx, dy, scale, angle, cx, cy)`: moved by that transform and drawn at the layer row's position (z-order). A layer named camera moves everything.

field.description: ODE: slope field (first-order equation against t) or vector field + dashed nullclines (2-D system in the phase plane). Default: shown for the graph's first such ODE.

phase.description: ODE: draw the coupled system (x' = ..., y' = ...) or a 2nd-order equation (as y, y') in the phase plane instead of against t. Needs a state of 2+ dimensions.

phaseAxes.description: ODE phase plane: the two state variables to plot for a 3+-D system, e.g. ["x", "z"] (default: the first two).

extraICs.description: ODE: extra solutions drawn thinner in the same colour, each [t0, y0, y0', ...] (the system's whole state at t0).

family.description: Slider: draw a family of 7 ghost solutions (functions and ODEs that use it) for values evenly spread across min..max.
